messages:
Tara Singh: Hi team, quick onboarding snag. I can log into Okta and 1Password but when I try to open the 'model-infra' Drive folder I get 'You need access' (403). Also my 1Password invite bounced back as undeliverable. Joined via the onboarding flow ~30m ago. Anyone know what's up? :wave:
Priya Patel: Welcome Tara! Can you paste the Drive link and confirm the email shown in the top-right of Drive? Also did the 1Password bounce include any bounce reason?
Tara Singh: Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ModelInfraExample. Drive shows tara.singh@redwood.com. The 1Password bounce said "recipient address rejected: user unknown". Weird since Okta shows me active.
it-provisioning-bot: Provisioning log: okta_user_created tara.singh@redwood.com at 2026-08-16T09:05:12Z; google_account_provisioned at 2026-08-16T09:06:00Z; 1password_invite_attempted at 2026-08-16T09:06:15Z -> bounce detected.
Samir Rao: Quick hint: we sometimes see a race where HR-provisioned alias doesn't match the canonical email in Okta for a small batch. That can cause downstream systems to reject the invite. Priya, can you check Tara's Okta primaryEmail vs login?
Priya Patel: Checking... Okta login is tara.s@redwood.com but primaryEmail is tara.singh@redwood.com. Our 1Password worker used the login field for invites which explains the bounce if the alias wasn't provisioned in the mail system yet. I'll requeue the 1Password invite to the canonical primaryEmail and add Tara to the 'eng-models' Drive group to unblock access.
DevX Bot: Action queued: re-send 1Password invite to tara.singh@redwood.com; manual group add to eng-models. Audit record created.
Tara Singh: Thanks! After you add me, will Drive access be instant or is there a cache delay?
Samir Rao: Should be immediate for permissions, but Drive can show cached 403 for a minute or two. If you still see 403 after 2-3 minutes try incognito or clear cookies.
Priya Patel: Added tara.singh@redwood.com to eng-models and re-sent 1Password invite via one-time link DM. Also noticed a transient passkey registration error earlier; if your Okta MFA passkey flow fails try TOTP as a fallback.
Tara Singh: Incognito worked  I can open the folder now. Got the 1Password DM link and set my vault up. MFA passkey registration tried once and errored; registered TOTP to finish enrollment. Any docs on switching to passkey later?
Priya Patel: Yep — Profile -> Extra Verification Methods -> Add Passkey. If you hit errors (we had a passkey provider 502 earlier today) enroll TOTP now to unblock and try passkey again later. If it still fails ping me and I'll reset your passkey state from the admin console.
Tara Singh: One more thing: GitHub invite not showing yet. Will that arrive via SSO automatically? And do I need to add an SSH key?
Samir Rao: GitHub invites are separate and will be sent to the canonical email on your Okta profile shortly. SSH keys must be added by you. Example command: 
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "tara.singh@redwood.com"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
```
Tara Singh: Got the GitHub invite ~10m later and added my SSH key. Thanks everyone for the quick help  appreciate it! :tada:
